spec: TRANSFER.md v1.0 canon. Direction bm-a -> bm-b. Purpose: T-89/T-90 harvest finalize (both tickets claimed bm-b, single-finalization) requires the full 18-shard lane-local outputs; pool is 18/18 flipped done but 15 shard data files live on bm-a (r312 drain burned 13 shards in-round + X2 legacy LA/LD + deep DA also bm-a); bm-b local holds only curves_x2_legacy_LB/LC + curves_x2_deep_DB + two probe subsets. DATASET (30 files, repo-relative paths, ~91MB total, every file <95MB): DATA results/decision_chain/curves_x2_legacy_LA.jsonl, curves_x2_legacy_LD.jsonl, curves_x2_deep_DA.jsonl, curves_x2_deep_DC.jsonl, curves_x2_deep_DD.jsonl, curves_x2_deep_DE.jsonl; results/pros_segs/cells_legacy_LA.jsonl, cells_legacy_LB.jsonl, cells_legacy_LC.jsonl, cells_legacy_LD.jsonl, cells_deep_DA.jsonl, cells_deep_DB.jsonl, cells_deep_DC.jsonl, cells_deep_DD.jsonl, cells_deep_DE.jsonl; MARKERS done_x2_legacy_LA.json, done_x2_legacy_LD.json, done_x2_deep_DA.json, done_x2_deep_DC.json, done_x2_deep_DD.json, done_x2_deep_DE.json (results/decision_chain/) + done_legacy_LA.json, done_legacy_LB.json, done_legacy_LC.json, done_legacy_LD.json, done_deep_DA.json, done_deep_DB.json, done_deep_DC.json, done_deep_DD.json, done_deep_DE.json (results/pros_segs/). PLAN A (git transfer branch, <500MB threshold met): sender stages the 30 files into a TEMP staging tree mirroring repo-relative names, runs Tools/transfer_manifest.ps1 -Path <stage> -Out fleet/transfers/T-2026-09-27-93-sender.json -Hash, then git add -f the 30 in-place repo paths on branch transfer/t89t90-harvest-shards, commit+push, checkout main, and per D-20260925-01ii/T-31 law git checkout <branch> -- <paths> + git restore --staged to keep local faces intact. Receiver (bm-b): git fetch, checkout branch paths into worktree, git restore --staged per R90 law, overwrite local PROS probe-subset faces cells_legacy_LA.jsonl/done_legacy_LA.json (sender full 6908-cell faces supersede 22-cell probes, same names), rename local X2 probe files curves_x2_legacy_lA.jsonl/done_x2_legacy_lA.jsonl to .probe-bak suffix (finalize union poison guard), stage-received-verify via transfer_manifest.ps1 -Hash + write T-2026-09-27-93-receiver.json, flip ticket done with dual-manifest result_ref. Honest faces: any file absent on bm-a = report in reply MSG with the missing list, do NOT fabricate; sender manifest anchors bytes+SHA256 per file.
note: Harvest critical path, non-blocking send leg: bm-a next round claim (claim=status claimed + claimed_by + claimed_at + commit) then send in same round per O-1730 claim-and-start law; transfer process Start-Process backgrounded per TRANSFER.md 0.4 (no round blocking). Consumers after receipt: scripts/decision_chain_e2e.py finalize (G-CENSUS fail-closed on missing shards) + T-89 finalize (built r317, whole-axis census gates 22x1256 legacy / 22x1506 deep). Anti-dup: no existing transfer ticket/branch for this dataset (checked r317: no transfer/* branch newer than t80-*, fleet/transfers/ last manifest 09-26).
claimed_by: bm-a (OS iteration loop R314 S7 discovery; P1 transfer ticket = claim-and-start same round per collaboration law)
progress_r314_bma: R314 bm-a claim-and-start: sender-face inventory + Plan A staging + manifest + transfer branch push this round; honest missing-list face if any of the 30 absent
